criteria.core_research_question: Substantive independent question addressing the paper’s central accuracy, efficiency or applicability problem.
criteria.literature_and_sources: Relevant primary literature and independently retrieved data are traceable and critically assessed.
criteria.methods_and_controls: System choice, methods and controls are appropriate and justified; no prescribed fixed workflow.
criteria.native_evidence_and_reproducibility: Claims bind to authentic, reproducible analysis or native execution evidence, with independent execution authentication where new computation is claimed.
criteria.uncertainty_and_validity: Numerical convergence, uncertainty, state identity and model validity are addressed where scientifically applicable.
criteria.efficiency_and_costs: Efficiency claims and resource use have evidence; failures and incomplete work are disclosed.
criteria.conclusions_and_limitations: The research question is answered by evidence, without treating transcription or fabricated results as new research.

review_policy: Full credit requires a trusted host-supplied independent review passing every criterion and bound to the exact submitted artifact manifest, rubric and verifier. Pending review receives no awarded credit and remains scientifically unvalidated.
